main_body: A round leafy bush canopy blob with no trunk, filled with a noisy mix of three greens and a near-black outline
top_band: none: the column scan shows random alternating light, mid and dark green runs of 1-6 rows, with no distinct top band and no front-face step
evidence: This is an organic foliage mass drawn as a roughly round clump. The column scans at x=12, 24 and 35 show only noisy alternation of L=155, 94 and 64 greens, so there is no light top surface stepping down to a separate front face. It has no volumetric top and front structure: no top band, no front edge, no eave shadow. Under the strict rule, when in doubt, fail.

style.evidence: The candidate has only 4 distinct colours (three greens plus a black outline) and a median of 4 colours per tile, against about 108 per tile and 427-567 colours in the references. All of its dark edge pixels are neutral (100%), which is the near-black sticker outline. The references use tinted dark-green and brown outlines. The leaf texture is a noisy dither of three greens with no clumps shaded in a ramp, no highlights and no volumetric shading. It has no trunk and reads as a flat green blob next to the references' layered canopies. Flat-fill coverage is 0%, but only because of the dithering, which is not real shading craft.
